comment: Explicit dispositions for every schema definition against the pinned SDK v1.8.0. 'alias' maps to a reviewed public SDK type; 'owned' emits an owned framework type (deprecated or sealed SDK surfaces); 'owned-codec' converts only through the public InputRequestMap/InputResponseMap codecs per G23. Dispositions are input to stage 3 emission and are validated for totality.
